title: Music and new sounds
notes: Tallgrass has a soundtrack! Every island has its own music, and so do the Safari Zone and battles. If you already play, it starts off: turn it on in Settings, under Sound, and set how loud you want it.
All new sound effects: buttons, ball throws, catches, fanfares and rare-find alerts. Pokémon cries are the same as ever.
New languages: Italiano, Português (Brasil) and 한국어.
Language in Settings now opens its own window.
Every search now works in your language as well as English.
changes: The game talks to the server a little less, to keep things running smoothly when lots of people are on.

title: The Safari Zone
notes: The Safari Zone is open to anyone with all 8 badges. It's an endgame area you walk by yourself, with your Buddy and Safari Balls, on a daily number of steps.
A new pool of 60 species every Monday, and far better odds for Shiny, Void, Prismatic and Perfect IVs. Once a day, a Golden Hour doubles them for 30 steps.
Throw by hand with Ball, Bait and Rock, or let your Catch rules do it. Shiny, Void, Prismatic, Spectral and Legendary finds rarely run.

Safari Tokens: earned from steps, rare finds and your Safari Dex. Spend them in the Safari Shop on Safari Balls, Longer Trips, Trail Mix, Scout's Focus, Costume Vouchers, Mints, Bottle Caps and cosmetics.
Ranger Outfit, both looks. Worn on a trip: special looks ×1.25 and encounters ×1.25. Auto-wear puts it on when you enter and back when you leave.
Safari Dex: catch a species, then reveal its card for Tokens. A full card earns a keepsake stamp.
Safari Ladder: your 5 best finds of the week add up. Rewards every Monday, and first place wins the Safari Champion frame.
Rare costume spawns, Safari outbreaks every 3 hours, and one costume outbreak a day. Event costumes only appear during their event.
Wishlist: star up to 6 species, and the Safari tab shows a dot the week one comes up.
New Egg settings switch: no big card for Perfect IVs when eggs hatch by themselves.
changes: Pokémon found while the game was offline can't go in the Day Care's pens, Hearth or Nanny seat any more. Any already there go back to your PC.
fixes: While the Two saves card was up, an older copy of your save could keep hunting behind it, then lose those finds when you picked the other copy. It now waits for your pick.

title: Language fix
fixes: Playing in German, Spanish or French could freeze the game for up to a minute, most often when opening Friends after switching language. Fixed.
